scope: Miao Chapter 21 (pp. 737-784): repeated games with perfect monitoring (one-shot deviation principle, self-generation, factorization, the maximal fixed point, computation, simple strategies), imperfect public monitoring (PPE, the noisy prisoner's dilemma), dynamic stochastic games and Markov perfect equilibrium, the Great Fish War, credible government policies (the APS value set, best and worst SPE values, recursive strategies), and Exercises 1-6.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 21
